description: This file declares the API functions for the Broadway Web Resource Manager's Environment Controller component, including creation, removal, initialization, and object enrollment functions.

methods.name: BwrmCreateEnvController
methods.description: Creates an environment controller object with specified container, owner, and reserved contexts.

methods.name: BwrmEcoCreate
methods.description: Creates an instance of the BWRM Eco object with specified contexts.

methods.name: BwrmEcoRemove
methods.description: Removes the specified Eco object instance.

methods.name: BwrmEcoEnrollObjects
methods.description: Enrolls necessary objects into the Eco object.
